name: s8_trajectory
title: RL raises reconstruction and stating the code language, not stating structure; the warm start sets that
caption: The NLA at ten points of its history on the exp 22 public bank: text-only warm start (base model given the prefix text under the warm-start instruction; shaded), the activation warm start (SFT, no RL), and GRPO adapters every 100 steps to 800. Left: judge-stated rate on the seven structural rows (40 items x 8 readouts per cell; faint = each row, bold = median). Middle: code language, judge (item-clustered bootstrap 95%) and strict regex 'names' rate on 160 k=1 readouts (Wilson 95%). Right: reconstruction (FVE) of the critic's rebuild of k=1 readouts, bold = Python strings, grey = the other rows (no per-item values saved, so no CI). Caveat: one final critic scores every checkpoint, so carrying and reconstruction are 'in a direction the final critic reads'.
